subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should authenticated plugin pages extend the shipped registerControlUiDescriptor tab contract, or should OpenClaw intentionally introduce registerControlUiEntryPoint as a second permanent public API?
rationale: Both approaches are technically possible, but choosing the permanent Plugin SDK and Control UI ownership model affects existing external plugins, protocol compatibility, documentation, and the security boundary; code review cannot safely select that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend the shipped tab contract
options.body: Add the scoped launch/session authorization to existing tab descriptors and remove the parallel entry-point registration and projection path.

options.title: Approve a parallel entry-point API
options.body: Keep both contracts only with an explicit distinction, compatibility plan, migration guidance, and coverage proving why existing tabs cannot use the new authorization flow.

options.title: Pause for the broader UI RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 establish the permanent plugin UI model.

recommendation.title: Extend the shipped tab contract
recommendation.body: Add the scoped launch/session authorization to existing tab descriptors and remove the parallel entry-point registration and projection path.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the current plugin-tab contract across the plugin registry, Gateway, and Control UI and is the strongest available owner for choosing its successor or extension.
